crossRefs.note: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.
From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.
David struck also Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.
God raised up an adversary to him, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah.
David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah to Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

people.name: Zobah
people.line: An Aramean kingdom, enemy of Israel during David's reign

translations.web: Solomon went to Hamath Zobah, and prevailed against it.
translations.bsb: Then Solomon went to Hamath-zobah and captured it.
